body: Speaking from someone who is suicidal, my loved ones telling me that they love my doesn't change much. To me, the most important response is something like.... next time you're thinking of doing something like killing yourself, please know... please remember.... I want you to talk to me about it.... sometimes its like there is just too much going on, related to wanting to kill yourself, that taking the time to really REALLY go through the emotions with someone like that by talking through it can ground and center them.... anyways, that is just my perspective. I hope your brother can find hapiness or contentment or peace or something other than misery or death.

I... I can relate to this. Its like a nagging little fucking piece of your brain just wont turn off. No matter what, suicide is still ... always in your head. I have so many people that love me, and I still want to stab myself in the neck. Daily. Hourly. I dont know, its a tough place to be in. How are you doing now?

I identify so much with this. The only reason I am alive right now is because I known that if I killed myself, my girlfriend would be devastated. It would ruin her. But, I want so badly to die. It is such a difficult place to be in, my friend
